title: Impact of PARF Reduction on New Car Prices, Depreciation Rates and COE Renewal Behaviour
what_it_is: Impact of PARF Reduction on New Car Prices, Depreciation Rates and COE Renewal Behaviour

sections.label: PARF rebate lowered for EVs
sections.summary: PARF rebate was lowered and its cap cut from $60,000 to $30,000 as EVs make early deregistration incentives less needed.

sentences.speaker: Mr Jeffrey Siow
sentences.text: With electric vehicles (EVs) becoming more commonplace, there is now less of a need to encourage early deregistration through the PARF rebate.

sentences.speaker: Mr Jeffrey Siow
sentences.text: This is why we lowered the PARF rebate and also reduced the rebate cap from $60,000 to $30,000.

sentences.speaker: Mr Jeffrey Siow
sentences.text: We do not expect the changes to affect Certificate of Entitlement (COE) renewal behaviour significantly.

sentences.speaker: Mr Jeffrey Siow
sentences.text: The recent changes to vehicle taxes were implemented with immediate effect, in line with our general approach on market sensitive tax changes.

sections.label: Affected car buyers with purchases
sections.summary: Fewer than 2,000 car buyers with committed purchases are estimated affected, mostly higher-end internal combustion engine car buyers.

sentences.speaker: Mr Jeffrey Siow
sentences.text: Fewer than 2,000 car buyers with committed purchases are estimated to be affected.

sentences.speaker: Mr Jeffrey Siow
sentences.text: These include mostly buyers of higher-end internal combustion engine cars.

sentences.speaker: Mr Jeffrey Siow
sentences.text: Buyers with existing purchase agreements who have yet to secure a COE may wish to discuss with their dealers to come to a mutually acceptable agreement.

sections.label: Ownership and usage controls balance
sections.summary: Singapore needs a balance of ownership and usage controls, and PARF was adjusted because increased EV take-up made its original objective less relevant.

sentences.speaker: Mr Victor Lye (Ang Mo Kio)
sentences.text: And if so, can Singaporeans have a sense of the roadmap so as to make better transport decisions, private or public otherwise?

sentences.speaker: Mr Jeffrey Siow
sentences.text: I think we will always need a balance of both ownership as well as usage controls, both of which are necessary and important to keep road congestion in check.

sentences.speaker: Mr Jeffrey Siow
sentences.text: And depending on the outcomes, potentially we can then adjust our ownership policies and our vehicle quotas accordingly.

sentences.speaker: Mr Jeffrey Siow
sentences.text: We had decided to make adjustments to the PARF rate precisely because the take-up of EVs has increased, and this has made the original objective of PARF, which was to encourage early renewal of vehicles and therefore, have a younger vehicle fleet that is less pollutive, that initial objective is now less relevant with the take-up of EVs.
